targets.name: Bee painted on the large jar
targets.concealment: Tiny wing and leg marks merge into the jar's dark floral stems and follow its curved glazed surface.

targets.name: Blue-bird tile behind the vessels
targets.concealment: The tile's figures and border share the blue floral patterns of neighboring vessels; pottery hides part of its lower edge.

targets.name: Small blue-and-white bird figurine
targets.concealment: Its painted feather marks blend into the similarly patterned plates and cups, with feet tucked against the shelf.

targets.name: Leaping rabbit painted on the front bowl
targets.concealment: The little brown form is integrated into painted foliage and bends with the bowl surface, among similar leaf shapes.

targets.name: Green lizard painted on the cup
targets.concealment: The lizard's green limbs and long tail merge with painted leaves and curve with the blue floral cup.

targets.name: Blue fish painted on the hanging jug
targets.concealment: Blue fins share the surrounding blue flower stems and follow the curved hanging vessel; part of the far edge meets the scene crop.

targets.name: Brass scissors on the cabinet
targets.concealment: Thin gold blades align with the cabinet joinery and repeated curved vessel handles.

targets.name: Wooden pestle in the mortar
targets.concealment: The lower handle disappears behind the bowl rim, and its grain resembles adjacent wicker and cloth.

targets.name: Horizontal spool of twine
targets.concealment: Fine rope fibers repeat basket weave and the woven counter cloth; the spool lies at an oblique angle.

targets.name: Brass ruler beside the scissors
targets.concealment: The narrow gold ruler follows the cabinet grain and shares the adjacent hardware color; another brass instrument and the scissors repeat its thin silhouette.

targets.name: Two olives on the branch
targets.concealment: The fruit shares the greens of surrounding painted foliage; the pair lies against dense woven cloth beside overlapping real leaves.

targets.name: Sleeping cat on the shelf
targets.concealment: A clearly recognizable sleeping cat rests on the middle shelf.

targets.name: Whole foreground pomegranate
targets.concealment: Large red fruit is an obvious foreground shape.

targets.name: Tall brass coffee pot
targets.concealment: Tall metal pot with a long spout stands clearly at the left of the shelf.

targets.name: Hanging jug with the deer
targets.concealment: Large hanging cream jug with a brown deer is a clear anchor.

review.notes: Every target inspected against the finished source and regenerated contour context sheets. Names, full visible defining features, occlusion edges and negative-space holes repaired where needed. Difficulty is an authored estimate; physical iPhone/player calibration remains pending.
